## 1. Design: an Imprimatur marker on what Imprimatur owns

`byImprimatur` (vscode/agent-setup.js, #228) sets `by: "Imprimatur"` on a setup row when one of these holds, by the row's `kind`:

- **installed plugin:** the plugin id starts with `imprimatur@` or `imprimatur-private@`.
- **MCP instructions / tools** (a "This session" row): the row's label matches `imprimatur` as a whole segment (`/(^|[_:])imprimatur([_:]|$)/i`), e.g. Imprimatur's own MCP server.
- **hook output** (a "This session" row): not a merged "one of" row, and either the hook's script path mentions `imprimatur` (`isImprimaturHook`, its path or its `IMPRIMATUR_` env) or its details already say `Imprimatur (…)`.
- **any other file-backed row:** the file starts with Imprimatur's generated header (`<!-- Generated by Imprimatur`), as `.claude/rules/imprimatur.md` does; or, for a `skill` row, its folder resolves (through a symlink) into an Imprimatur checkout: `<checkout>/skills/<name>/`, where `<checkout>/package.json` is named `imprimatur`.

`.claude/imprimatur.json` and anything under `.claude/imprimatur/` are not setup rows at all: `classify()` has no case for `imprimatur.json`, and `findAgentFiles` skips walking into `.claude/imprimatur/` outright ("Imprimatur's own data … not setup"), so neither needs a marker.

The tree puts `Imprimatur · ` at the start of the description of such a row: setup items, merged hooks and the hooks in "For <file>". A settings file that holds both Imprimatur's hooks and the user's own is not marked, since its hook rows already are.

Analyze: the detection is read-only and works per row. A false negative leaves a row unmarked, which is no worse than today. Nothing else reads `by`.

Checked against the code (2026-11-19): corrected — this section described an earlier, four-bullet version of the rule (file header; "Imprimatur's own config: `.claude/imprimatur.json` or anything under `.claude/imprimatur/`"; a skill's checkout; `imprimatur@…` plugin id) and a separate hook rule. `byImprimatur` in `vscode/agent-setup.js` is now kind-dispatched and covers plugins (now also `imprimatur-private@…`), MCP/tools rows and hook-output rows from "This session" by their own logic, falling back to the file-header/skill-checkout check for everything else; `.claude/imprimatur.json`/`.claude/imprimatur/` are excluded from the scan before `byImprimatur` ever runs, so they were never actually marked by the old "own config" bullet either. Rewritten above to match.
